script: OpenAI just gave ChatGPT a tiny coworker with its own computer — and it doesn’t clock out. They’re called Dots. Instead of living inside one chat bubble, a Dot can connect to your apps, use its own cloud computer, and keep chewing through a multi-step job in the background. OpenAI is pitching them for real work and personal errands, with specialist Dots for companies, and teams of Dots planned later. But here’s the catch: sensitive actions can still need your approval, and right now Dots require an eligible paid ChatGPT plan, while Meta’s Muse offers a free tier. So the next AI race isn’t just who has the smartest chatbot. It’s who gets to become your always-on digital coworker. Would you give one the keys?
audience: AI-curious adults and knowledge workers deciding whether persistent agents deserve access to their apps
rationale: Derivation precedes staging: introduce/name persistent agency; escape/connect; provision a separate computer; advance an assigned job; propose uses; specialize; qualify future collaboration; interrupt for permission; compare access conditions; reframe competition; invite entrusted access. Adjacent propositions share a setup only while their governing rule develops. The opening introduces a small notched Dot token, connected work establishes its consequential behavior, and the ending returns that token to an unresolved access decision. Permission, commercial eligibility and future teamwork receive separate worlds. Supplied primary-source claim summaries support narration; references support material identity, hierarchy and persistence only. Interfaces and examples are explicitly illustrative, without product screenshots, performance measurements or claims of task success.
metaphor: An identifiable notched agent token moves from the edge of conversation into consequential work, then encounters the boundaries of entrusted access. Each semantic world has its own physical rule; the token supplies continuity without carrying entire environments.

Requested SVG bundle: enlarged generic app tabs, mating connector faces, recessed cloud workspace, and an identifiable research brief with two source folds that consolidate into an unfinished draft. No app logos or purported product UI.
Requested SVG bundle: business brief and household planning envelope; specialist task fittings with permanent PREVIEW band; translucent team diagram under a closed PLANNED LATER cover.
Requested SVG bundle: sensitive-change envelope, arresting paper stop, untouched approval control and scoped-access key with app-tab teeth. Same key returns in the closing invitation.
Requested SVG bundle: equal-size Dots and Muse entry leaves with different admission requirements; no scores, exclusive price, winner badge or unlimited-free claim.
Requested SVG bundle: fold-out editorial comparison object whose conversation face reveals a persistent-work face; isolated user-side key cradle and agent-side receiving recess.

Requested production-scoped action and anchor contracts, not executable existing selectors: agency unfolding, connector engagement, job-state replacement, scope replacement, provisional-cover reveal, conditional permission stop, access-leaf comparison, editorial fold and unresolved key presentation. Extend registered paper and interactive UI adapters only after review.

limitations: Data-only proposal. No tools, code, files, web verification, speech generation, rendering or independent critic execution occurred. Claims rely on the supplied verified packet as of 2026-10-03; reference claims are not evidence.

Structure and direction are NOT_ASSESSED by independent critics. This plan grants no PASS, production approval or authorization to advance. A fresh independent structure PASS must precede direction review, speech generation and moving rough.

All listed production assets, metadata and action contracts are requested additions, not existing files, selectors, anchors or registered capabilities. Create and review them under this project's assets/props/ only; do not promote canonical assets.

Exact shared puppet, font, material, event-engine, caption and adapter paths were not supplied. The reused asset record deliberately leaves paths empty; registry resolution is required before compilation. Canonical Motif Bot v1 geometry remains locked.

Reuse registered paper finite actions where their complete contracts fit; use interactive-ui-v1 for its registered bot performance and reaction target. Calendar/arena and workshop adapters remain available but are not forced into unrelated access, specialization or future-team worlds.

Requested action kinds: agency-unfold, assigned-work-persist, boundary-peel, connector-engage, cloud-input-seat, job-state-replace, background-layer-continue, scope-replace, specialist-fit-reveal, provisional-cover-reveal, conditional-permission-stop, access-leaf-compare, editorial-fold-reframe and unresolved-key-present. They require explicit production-scoped adapter development and registration before compilation.

Requested anchor maps: computer hinges and assignment folds; Bot seam grip; connector mating faces and passage stop; cloud recess landing; source/draft folds and Bot grip/release; proposal hinges and fitting; specialist reveal and token seat; provisional cover and sealed joint; permission arrest, outgoing boundary and untouched control; admission-leaf hinges; editorial face hinge and token seat; final cradle stop and receiving recess. These names describe requirements, never proposed selectors claimed to exist.

Held materials require inverse grip resolution after main and local transforms. Unsupported attachment or focal/framing bindings block compilation. Only registered bot reaction targets are enrolled; other contact deformation belongs to explicitly requested reviewed choreography, not invented reaction selectors.

New SVG artwork descriptions are direction requirements. Begin with moving rough placeholders; no final artwork before both independent moving critics pass with and without captions. The rejected original stays frozen.

Actual exact-script Kokoro timings at the approved speed drive duration and lexical caption alignment. Use natural short coral paper chunks with stable letters; no scene, event, reaction, particle or duration quotas. No audio finishing in this rough-review task.
Reference evidence consists of supplied stills and ordered strips. Easing, exact contacts, continuous performance, audio synchronization and moving compliance remain unassessed.

Inspect declared contacts using consecutive native windows of six frames before and after each event, clipped to beat boundaries, alongside full-rate traces and playback. All ten quality gates and hierarchy diagnoses require explicit assessment; technical success is separate.

Allow at most two meaningful moving repairs within the supplied brief. Final moving QA, technical validation, audio boundaries and final human watching/listening approval remain required for any later final production. This proposal neither publishes nor grants sensitive-action approval.

The headline and permanent local qualification bands preserve PREVIEW, PLANNED LATER, conditional approval, eligible paid access and bounded free-tier meaning when narration captions are removed. Illustrative task states do not claim product UI, benchmark results, successful task completion or unrestricted proactive actions.
